name: lightsail
description: Web UI to provision a Lightsail Ubuntu instance via AWS CLI

scripts.mobile: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; cd mobile && flutter run'
scripts.mobile:apk: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; cd mobile && flutter build apk --release'
scripts.mobile:ios: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; cd mobile && flutter build ios --release'
